test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
{1, 4, 7, 12, 13, 10, 11, 0, 0, 18, 37, 33, 29, 27, 16, 25, 28, 17, 19}

What are the Mean, the Median and the Mode of the above set of data, in the same order, corrected to two decimal places?
solution:
**Formula Used:**

Mean = Sum of all observations/Number of observation

**Calculation:**

Mean:

⇒ (0 + 0 + 1 + 4 + 7 + 10 + 11 + 12 + 13 + 16 + 17 + 18 + 19 + 25 + 27 + 28 + 29 + 33 + 37)/19

⇒ 307/19 = 16.16

Median:

Ascending order:

{0, 0, 1, 4, 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 16, 17, 18, 19, 25, 27, 28, 29, 33, 37}

⇒ The middle value is 16 so, the median is 16.

Mode:

Only {0} is repeated 2 times

⇒ 0 is repeating maximum time so, the mode is 0.

**Hence, the mean, median and mode are 16.16, 16, 0 respectively.**
